-- Calculate AHR and total monthly therapy hours for P871358
WITH latest_enc AS (
    SELECT enc_key, ab_ref 
    FROM encounters 
    WHERE pat_ref = 'P871358' 
    ORDER BY time_mark DESC LIMIT 1
),
ab_data AS (
    SELECT ab.ab_key, ab.pat_owner_ref, ab.therapy_exp_intensity
    FROM assessmentbasics ab 
    JOIN latest_enc le ON ab.ab_key = le.ab_ref
),
asd_data AS (
    SELECT asd.dx_dur_m, asd.prev_hosp
    FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd
    JOIN ab_data ab ON asd.asd_key = ab.ab_key
),
treatment_hours AS (
    SELECT SUM(tb.th_dur_m) as total_th_dur_m
    FROM treatmentbasics tb
    JOIN latest_enc le ON tb.enc_ref = le.enc_key
)
SELECT 
    ad.dx_dur_m,
    ad.prev_hosp,
    ROUND(CAST(ad.prev_hosp AS numeric) / (CAST(ad.dx_dur_m AS numeric) / 12), 4) as ahr,
    th.total_th_dur_m
FROM ab_data ab
JOIN asd_data ad ON TRUE
CROSS JOIN treatment_hours th;

-- Find the facility associated with the patient's last encounter
SELECT e.enc_key, e.clin_id, c.clin_key, c.fac_connect, f.fac_key, f.r_source
FROM encounters e
JOIN clinicians c ON e.clin_id = c.clin_key
JOIN facilities f ON c.fac_connect = f.fac_key
WHERE e.pat_ref = 'P871358'
ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC LIMIT 1;

-- Verify: check if there are any other encounters for this patient
SELECT e.enc_key, e.time_mark, COUNT(tb.tx_key) as num_treatments, SUM(tb.th_dur_m) as total_th_hours
FROM encounters e
LEFT JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref
WHERE e.pat_ref = 'P871358'
GROUP BY e.enc_key, e.time_mark
ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC;
